title: Quechua, Eastern Apurímac Language (QVE) - Ethnologue
text: Eastern Apurímac Quechua is a stable indigenous language of Peru. It belongs to the Quechuan language family and is part of the Quechua macrolanguage. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is taught as a subject of instruction in education.
